description: Source and version state, jurisdictional, local, and discounted HWAU price schedules over time with provenance and support status.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository now has a runtime PriceRegistry API, public NEP-backed national rows, public-safe synthetic state/local/discounted fixtures, and fail-closed unavailable/blocked behavior. It does not claim complete official sourced state/local price coverage or redistribution rights for restricted local schedules.

implemented: runtime PriceRegistry API for national, state, local, and discounted rows
public NEP-backed national rows from shared pricing constants
local-only synthetic state, local, discounted, missing, and blocked fixtures
fail-closed lookup behavior for unavailable or non-redistributable schedules
not_implemented: complete official sourced registry for every jurisdiction and year
redistribution of restricted local or licensed price schedules
public claim that synthetic state/local constants are official prices

gap_register.description: The price_registry module now exposes PriceRegistry, get_state_price, get_national_price, get_local_price, get_discounted_price, list_available_years, and list_available_jurisdictions APIs with public-safe fixture coverage.
gap_register.rationale: Runtime behavior is implemented for public NEP rows and synthetic/local-only fixtures; official state/local source coverage remains a separate source gap.

gap_register.description: State, local, discounted, missing, and blocked schedule rows still need official provenance records before any public sourced support claim beyond the national NEP rows.
gap_register.rationale: Synthetic and local-only fixtures exercise behavior without redistributing or overclaiming official state/local prices.
